WE DO NOT ACCEPT RESERVATIONS.'; 'In Season / Water is Turned On / April 15th to November 15th / $25.00 per Day/Night / Anyone parking in Electrical/Water Pull-through Sites 1-13 & Sites 16-25 ... $15.00 per Day/Night PRIMITIVE Camping/Tent Area (no hook-ups) Sites 14 & 15 and EAST end of campground'; 'Off Season / Water is Turned Off / November 15th to April 15th / $20.00 per Day/Night' (same sites), '$10.00' primitive; 'Self-Pay Box | Next to Bathhouse'; city phone 785.726.4812.

https://ellis.ks.us/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/campground-brochure.pdf (City of Ellis brochure, uploaded 2023-10), read 2026-11-06: same rates and sites; Off Season 'Bathhouse is Closed - No Water Hook-ups'; 'For more information, call City of Ellis at 785.726.4812'.

Esri World Imagery (38.9396,-99.5560 at 300 m; town at 1.1 km), 2026-11-06: 'Ellis City Lake' is the impounded channel of Big Creek, ~40-50 m wide, meandering ~1.5 km through town (roughly 15-20 acres). The angled pull-throughs sit south of the campground road, which runs along a tree line on the bank; the nearest pads are ~30-50 m from the water, with the road and trees between them and the water.

values.note: No attendant on site: all sites are first come, first served, with payment at the self-pay box next to the bathhouse. No reservations.

values.note: City of Ellis: electric and water pull-throughs $25 a night from April 15 to November 15, $20 a night off season, when there is no water or bathhouse. Primitive sites $15, or $10 off season. Self-pay. Read 2026-11-06 (same on the 2026-07-13 Wayback capture).

note: City of Ellis campground on the tree-shaded banks of Ellis City Lake, an impounded reach of Big Creek, seven blocks south of I-70 exit 145. No attendant on site. There is a boat dock and a fishing pier. --Claude
